paragraphs: On 15 August 2020, at Kaeo Samui 1 Room, Kaeo Samui Hotel, Surat Thani Province, Ms. Bunthom Kranthong, Deputy Secretary-General of the Royal Society, chaired the judging of the final round of the Storytelling Contest “Local Wisdom: Food, Toys and Utensils”, Group 4, Southern Region, attended by the judging committee, contestants and the teachers who coached students selected in the first round

The results are as follows. First prize: Master Sarut Thongsong, Ban Khuha Sawan Municipal School, Phatthalung Province, receives a scholarship of 12,000 baht and a certificate. First runner-up: Miss Ananyalak Suk-iat, Municipal School 1 (Ban Udom Thong Community), Songkhla Province, receives a scholarship of 10,000 baht and a certificate. Second runner-up: Miss Nattakan Ritthirong, Wat Phuphaphimuk Municipal School, Phatthalung Province, receives a scholarship of 8,000 baht and a cert

Honorable mentions: Miss Natchaya Sangkhakit, Ban Na Thong School, Songkhla Province; Miss Tasnim Narawan, Anuban Tha Phae School, Satun Province; Miss Nithanan Chansuksri, Wat Khuan Sai School, Nakhon Si Thammarat Province; Miss Nisrin Langitan, Ban Khlong Khut School, Satun Province; Miss Panakawin Chaithong, Wat Chai Chumphon Municipal School, Nakhon Si Thammarat Province; Miss Mukkhanda Mukkharatsada, Wat Khuan Tha Rae School, Surat Thani Province; and Master Arofat Wangdi, Ban Rai Yai School, Trang Province. Honorable mention recipients each receive a scholarship of 3,000 baht and a certificate
